entities.name: Influenza A neuraminidase Q07579
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q07579, influenza A virus A/Equine/Miami/1/1963 (H3N8).
470 aa; calculated molecular mass 51,969 Da; theoretical pI 6.27.
Sialidase (EC 3.2.1.18) removes terminal sialic acid residues from glycoconjugates; reference annotation reports Ca2+ cofactor.
Reference annotation places protein as a type II single-pass membrane protein in virion and host apical membranes; Pfam Neur domain spans query residues 73–461.
